lines.text: Many learners say: Can you pull a photo of us?
Better: Can you take a photo of us?
Take! Please take a photo of me.

data.wrong: Can you pull a photo of us?
data.right: Can you take a photo of us?
data.memory: Can you take a photo of us?

native.tip: Türkçede “fotoğraf çekmek” deriz; İngilizcede “pull” değil, “take” kullanılır: “Can you take a photo of us?”
native.caption: “Can you pull a photo of us?” mi diyorsun? 😅 “Fotoğraf çekmek” İngilizcede “pull” ile değil, “take a photo” ile söylenir. Doğrusu “Can you take a photo of us?” Carlos’u dinle ve tekrar et! Lexkite uygulamasını aç, daha çok pratik yap.
native.comment: Cevap: “take”. Fotoğraf için “take a photo” de. Şimdi kendi cümleni yaz ve sesli söyle: {link}

en.tip: In English we say “take a photo,” not “pull”: “Can you take a photo of us?”
en.caption: Do you say “Can you pull a photo of us?” 😅 In English we say “take a photo” and never “pull a photo” for this. The right sentence is “Can you take a photo of us?” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Open the Lexkite app and practice more.
